captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for 5 < pT < 10 GeV.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.9, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=2.338; The resulting scale factor is 0.9956 +/- 0.0015.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0.9 < |eta| < 1.2, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.677; The resulting scale factor is 0.9969 +/- 0.0040.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 1.2 < |eta| < 2.4, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.947; The resulting scale factor is 0.9963 +/- 0.0018.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties. Bins without a valid fit are omitted. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for the single 5-10 GeV pT bin.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
